title: Bitfinex launches as a P2P margin-lending platform
description: Bitfinex's own anniversary retrospective states that the platform was born on 6 November 2012 and initially launched as a peer-to-peer margin-lending platform for Bitcoin.
notes: This is the verified origin of the P2P margin-lending service lineage. It does not assert when the later Margin Funding label was first used.

title: Poloniex begins rollout of Poloniex Earn
description: Poloniex announced the rollout of Poloniex Earn as a suite of cryptocurrency investment products, with the first Polo Earn products to follow.
notes: The first official Polo Earn subscriptions opened on 4 January 2023.

title: First Polo Earn subscriptions open
description: Poloniex opened official subscriptions for its first batch of Polo Earn products at 00:00 UTC on 4 January 2023.
notes: This records the first subscription opening separately from the 28 December 2022 rollout announcement.
